name: Hub API Server
description: Inter-app message hub. Apps register with the hub on startup, exchange async messages, and declare data they expose. Runs as its own binary, vct-hub, on localhost (port 7700 unless configured — see the VCT_HUB_PORT setting); this manifest enables the UI to show its status in the module dashboard.

install._note: The hub is its own binary, vct-hub (source: launcher/src-tauri/vct-hub/), shipped and updated with the launcher — not installed from this manifest. This entry describes the hub to the module catalog; the manifest's install block is not executed for it.

settings.description: Default 7700. Change if you have a port conflict, then restart the hub. Machine-wide: the hub reads this module's GLOBAL setting row (launcher.db, no project) when it starts; a VCT_HUB_PORT in the hub process's own environment overrides it. Clients find the running hub through <vct root>/hub.port, which the hub writes after binding.

runtime._note: command=builtin:hub is a sentinel — nothing spawns the hub from this manifest (the launcher, the session hooks and the boot units each start the vct-hub binary). So the VCT_HUB_PORT setting is not passed through env_from_settings: the hub reads it itself at start (vct-hub server.rs resolve_bind_port), so its port never depends on which of those started it. health_check.url and provides[].base_url name the port as {hub_port}, which the launcher's placeholder expander (vct_launcher_core::manifest::PlaceholderCtx::resolve) replaces with the RUNNING hub's port: <vct root>/hub.port, else VCT_HUB_PORT, else 7700 (vct_launcher_core::services::hub_port, the same ladder the module supervisor uses for a container's VCT_HUB_BASE_URL). The file wins because the hub walks past a taken port. 127.0.0.1, not localhost: the hub binds IPv4 and localhost can resolve to ::1. The hub's module health poller (vct-hub src/module_health.rs) probes this URL as it does every module's runtime.health_check, and the launcher's module tile shows the result; the launcher's own reachability probe and the session hook's pid check are separate liveness checks.

uninstall._note: Cannot be uninstalled independently of the launcher.

provides.description: POST /apps/register, GET /apps, POST /messages, GET /messages/{app_id}, POST /data/register, GET /data/catalog, GET /health
